title: [Bug]: PDU session fails when changing the DNN configuration of a registered UE.
body:
### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag

v2.6.4

### Steps to reproduce

1. Configure and deploy open5gs with two UPFs (1 UPF is on a remote location) and two DNNs (each DNN associated to one of the UPFs).
2. Register a UE to the core and assign it to DNN-1 (nomad).
3. Connect UE, set the APN setting to DNN-1, and test that the PDU session is up and there is external network connectivity.
4. On the core, assign UE to a different DNN, i.e. DNN-2 (aws).
5. On the UE, set the APN setting to DNN-2. (there is no internet connectivity, data connectivity/5G icon shows up)
6. On the UE, trigger airplane mode ON/OFF a few times. (there is no internet connectivity, data connectivity/5G icon shows up)
7. Restart the UE. (there is no internet connectivity, data connectivity/5G icon shows up)
8. Restart all core components. (Internet connectivity restored)

### Logs

_No response_

### Expected behaviour

Be able to change the DNN configuration of registered UEs without restarting the phone or the Open5GS services. The following operation is expected:

1. (When the DNN configuration is changed on the core); PDU session on the UE drops.
2. (When the new APN configuration is applied on the UE); a new PDU session is created which is also associated to a different UPF.

### Observed Behaviour

1. (When the DNN configuration is changed on the core); UE still shows that the PDU session is up and running.
2. (When the new APN configuration is applied on the UE); the UE shows that a new PDU session is established but AMF logs show "DNN Not Supported OR Not Subscribed in the Slice". There is no internet connectivity.
3. (When airplane mode is triggered ON/OFF for a few times on the UE); the UE shows that a new PDU session is established but AMF logs show "DNN Not Supported OR Not Subscribed in the Slice". There is no internet connectivity.
4. (When UE is power-cycled); the UE shows that a new PDU session is established but AMF logs show "DNN Not Supported OR Not Subscribed in the Slice". There is no internet connectivity.
5. (When Core is restarted); UE re-connects to the cell and successfully connects to the internet using the new APN configuration. No error/warning logs shown in the core.

### eNodeB/gNodeB

Nokia Airscale 22R4

### UE Models and versions

iPhone 14 Pro
